text: Artificial intelligence is quickly changing how we work. Automation now handles many repetitive tasks, such as organizing data and answering simple customer questions. This allows employees to focus on more creative and complex work. Productivity tools powered by AI, like smart calendars and writing assistants, help people save time and make fewer mistakes. Many companies are also exploring human-AI collaboration, where people and machines work together as a team. However, these changes mean that some jobs may disappear while new ones appear. Workers will need to learn new skills to stay competitive. Overall, AI offers great opportunities, but it also requires careful preparation and continuous learning.
